sources.entry: Voicely - Offline dictation into any app, call recording with speaker labels and audio/video file transcription, all on-device with a local speech model.

summary.one_liner: Voicely is a free, MIT-licensed, on-device dictation and transcription app for macOS (Apple Silicon) that also runs a local MCP server so AI agents can transcribe files and read calls and dictations.
summary.what_it_does: Press Option+Space to dictate text into whatever app has the cursor, using Accessibility for native fields, the clipboard and Cmd+V for Chromium/Electron apps, and typed text for terminals. It records calls by mixing system audio (via ScreenCaptureKit) with the microphone, then produces a speaker-separated transcript with "You" identified by mic activity. It transcribes any audio or video file, with optional speaker diarization, from the terminal (`voicely transcribe`) or via an agent tool. Transcripts are saved as plain markdown, JSONL and WAV files under ~/Documents/Voicely/. The `voicely mcp` stdio server exposes four tools (transcribe_file, list_transcripts, get_transcript, get_last_call), and `voicely connect` registers it with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes and OpenClaw. The speech model is NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 running via FluidAudio's CoreML port, covering 25 European languages.
use_cases: Dictate text into any Mac app with a hotkey
Transcribe recorded calls with speaker labels
Convert audio or video files to text offline
Give Claude Code or Codex access to transcripts via MCP
Keep private voice notes and dictations on-device
Pull action items from meeting recordings
how_to_run: git clone <repo> && cd Voicely && swift build -c release --product Voicely && swift build -c release --product VoicelyCLI
stack: yt-dlp (used by the skill for online video)
notable: Fully on-device: no account, cloud or subscription, and the MCP server works offline
Records system audio without a virtual audio device, using ScreenCaptureKit
Clipboard is restored after pasting into Chromium/Electron apps, and transcripts are marked so clipboard managers skip them
Registers the MCP server with several agent harnesses via each harness's own mcp add command
Transcripts are plain markdown files readable by any tool
caveats: Public build is signed with a self-made certificate and is not notarized by Apple
Speech model download is about 470 MB and the first prepare step takes about a minute
